disagreements.text: PowerPyx, Push Square and SixShore agree the trophy needs 18 spots, but the 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation (Lucia, Jason's house, morning after Down to Earth) raises the counter by one yet is not marked as a spot like the other 18 — nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it. PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked. Do it before Chapter 1 ends; it takes a minute and removes the risk.
disagreements.title: Meditation spots: 18 for the trophy, 15 for 100% — and is the Chapter 1 balcony one required?

disagreements.text: In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin: no guide has pinned down the exact trigger. PowerPyx gives a best-guess method for four of them (bar plus drink; Banshee plus window; Payday Loans store; UFO questline; motorcycle kick) and marks all five unconfirmed; KeenGamer and GTABase confirm the same five are unconfirmed, and Fair Game's animal is unconfirmed too. This guide shows the best guess and labels it unconfirmed — do not treat it as certain.
disagreements.title: Five trophies have no confirmed method yet

disagreements.text: GTABase and other guides place the final mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5, while PowerPyx's trophy text puts the final mission in Chapter 4 (Starting From Zero) and its Snow Storm text says Chapter 5. The mission name is agreed; only the chapter number differs. This guide follows the five-chapter structure and names the mission, not the chapter, for the finale.
disagreements.title: Which chapter is the finale?

disagreements.text: PowerPyx says cheats disable trophies and achievements and also disable saving. GTABase says the block lasts for the current session only (the GTA 5 / Red Dead 2 pattern). Either way: keep cheats off the save you use for the platinum run.
disagreements.title: Do cheats only block trophies for the session?

disagreements.text: PowerPyx: about 200 hours. Push Square: 250+ hours in its summary, up to 300 hours or more in its intro. TrueAchievements (via SixShore): well over 100 hours. The spread is the 100% checklist, not the story (60–80 hours everywhere). Budget 200 and expect the checklist to decide the rest.
disagreements.title: How long is the platinum — 200 or 300 hours?

disagreements.text: Most lists (Exophase, PSNProfiles, OutputLag, GTABase, U7BUY) count 28 hidden. Push Square marks 27. This guide follows the official list's 28.
disagreements.title: Hidden trophies: 28 or 27?

disagreements.text: PowerPyx flags one possibly missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude, the Chapter 1 balcony meditation). Push Square lists no known missables. Nobody has confirmed either way yet. Do the Chapter 1 meditation and the question goes away.
disagreements.title: Is anything missable at all?

disagreements.text: One source (TechWiser, via eGamers) says the chains behind five hidden trophies have story-linked windows and should be started as soon as they unlock. PowerPyx and SixShore say every trophy quest giver comes back and stays after the story. Start each chain when it unlocks — it costs nothing and covers both versions.
disagreements.title: Do the stranger chains have windows?

disagreements.text: OutputLag says character switching opens right after the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. PowerPyx and the top guides say both leads are only playable together after the later Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Partner trophies and the last meditation spots wait for the later unlock either way.
disagreements.title: When can both leads roam together?

disagreements.text: OutputLag and Push Square name two shooting range locations (Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range, Port Gellhorn; Griffin Shooting Range, Balsero). PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer count 12 range locations. All agree on the number that matters: 42 gold medals.
disagreements.title: Shooting ranges: 2 locations or 12?

disagreements.text: The official list (Exophase, PSNProfiles), GTABase, OutputLag, SixShore and U7BUY all list it Silver. Push Square's guide lists it Bronze. This guide follows the official list.
disagreements.title: Maximum Withdrawal: Silver or Bronze?

disagreements.text: Most lists mark it hidden. Push Square does not mark it hidden. The trophy is the same either way: max Strength on both Jason and Lucia at once.
disagreements.title: Is Personal Best hidden?

disagreements.text: PowerPyx calls it lenient, closer to 60% true completion (15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges). Push Square says you do not need everything but you do need almost everything. Both agree on the counts this guide lists per line.
disagreements.title: How lenient is the 100% checklist?

disagreements.text: PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models. Different counts of different things: the trophy needs 100 discovered vehicles, whichever list you count from.
disagreements.title: How many vehicles are there — 557 or 277?

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.role: Official list — every name, description, grade and PSN count

sources.name: Exophase
sources.role: Official list — every name, description, grade and hidden flag

trophies.guide: The platinum. Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own — no online trophy is needed and the whole list is single-player. Budget about 200 hours: 60–80 for the story, around 100 for the 100% checklist, around 10 for cleanup.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one unlocks automatically the moment the last one pops.
No online trophy is needed — the whole list is single-player, with no multiplayer or DLC trophies.
Budget about 200 hours: 60–80 for the story, around 100 for the 100% checklist, around 10 for cleanup.
On Xbox the same achievement is worth 0 Gamerscore — all 1,000 points come from the other 54 trophies.

trophies.guide: The opening mission. Complete Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 — it is the first mission of the game and unlocks automatically as the story starts.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1.
It unlocks automatically; there is nothing optional to do for it.
Story trophies cannot be missed — free roam continues after the credits, so keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter (15 slots plus 1 autosave) since there is no mission replay.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops a little late — once you clear the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? — which is normal for the chapter trophies.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops a little late, once you clear the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
Chapter trophies unlock as you play through the five chapters — none can be missed.
Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in the chapter that might not come back.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it pops once you start Chapter 3, after Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is also where the partner system opens up.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Finish Chapter 2; like the other chapter trophies it pops once you start Chapter 3, after Welcome to Vice City.
Chapter 2 is where the partner system opens up — several side trophies become possible only after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 unlocks the tools the robbery trophies need.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3; it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Chapter 3 unlocks the Snap Gun (via Yasmani's missions) and the dye pack jammer — both needed for robbery trophies later.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The trophy pops after the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Note the chapter-number disagreement about the finale — see the Sources disagree box.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Finish Chapter 4; the trophy pops after the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.
Chapter 4 holds three of the six specific-mission trophies, plus the bank-vault jobs that Maximum Withdrawal needs.

trophies.guide: The final mission. Complete it and the story is done — after the credits, free roam continues and everything else can be cleaned up. Keep cheats off this save.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Complete the final mission of the story.
After the credits, free roam continues — everything else can be cleaned up afterwards.
Do not use cheats on this save: they disable trophies and saving.
The final mission is Operation Savage Glory; guides disagree on whether it sits in Chapter 4 or Chapter 5 — the mission name is agreed, only the chapter number differs.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It is the first of the six specific-mission story trophies, and the mission the switching disagreement turns on.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
Mission trophies unlock automatically as the story advances — six of them are tied to specific main missions.
Some guides say character switching opens right after this mission; others say both leads are only playable together after the later mission Coffee Break.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. One of the six specific-mission story trophies — one in Chapter 2, one in Chapter 3, three in Chapter 4, one in Chapter 5.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.
It is one of the six specific-mission story trophies (one in Chapter 2, one in Chapter 3, three in Chapter 4, one in Chapter 5).

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Chapter 4 holds three of the six specific-mission trophies: this one, Headliners and VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.
Chapter 4 holds three of the six specific-mission trophies: this one, Headliners and VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. The second of Chapter 4's three specific-mission trophies, alongside Child's Play and VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.
Chapter 4 holds three of the six specific-mission trophies: Child's Play, this one and VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. The third of Chapter 4's three specific-mission trophies — and the mission that gives the airport its name for Catch Me If You Can.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.
Chapter 4 holds three of the six specific-mission trophies: Child's Play, Headliners and this one.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. GTABase places it in Chapter 5; PowerPyx's trophy text puts the final mission in Chapter 4 while its Snow Storm text says Chapter 5 — the mission name is agreed, only the chapter number differs.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.
GTABase places Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
PowerPyx's trophy text puts the final mission in Chapter 4 (Starting From Zero) while its Snow Storm text says Chapter 5.
It is the last of the six specific-mission story trophies (one in Chapter 2, one in Chapter 3, three in Chapter 4, one in Chapter 5).

trophies.guide: The big one: reach 100% completion. The checklist appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — and progress you made during the story already counts. It is lenient (closer to 60% true completion), but it still takes around 100 hours.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: The checklist appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion; progress you made during the story already counts.
Do 100 optional missions — there are several hundred in the game, far more than you need.

Robberies: 39 of 39 gang operations, 22 of 22 bank jobs, 7 of 7 payday loans, 8 of 8 bank vaults, 34 of 35 smash and grabs, 50 of 91 stick ups, plus $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 marked bills and $200,000 fenced vehicles.

Collectibles: 5 of 7 Kenton treasure sets, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 of 33 underwater discoveries, 30 of 34 magazines, books and comics, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 of 125 cocaine flamingos, 2 of 2 playlists, 70 of 79 styles, 200 of 277 base vehicles, 50 of 66 weapons, 100 of 255 animals.

Activities: 30 of 40 unique races won, 10 of 13 race challenge golds, 42 of 42 shooting range golds, all 4 video games played, 5 of 7 pool opponents, 2 of 3 mini golf courses, 90 of 100 basketball hoops, 42 of 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 15 Bret target decks.
PowerPyx calls the checklist lenient, closer to 60% true completion — most categories need only part of the total.
Nothing on the checklist is missable: every requirement stays available in free roam after the story.
This is the biggest single Gamerscore award in the game at 100G.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 in total — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps — and the quickest are the flights under bridges. Track them under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: There are 397 stunts in total: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
You need 250 for this trophy and 300 for 100% completion.
Flights under bridges are the quickest to rack up — fly your aircraft through the tight gaps and out the other side.
See all the stunts you have discovered on the map under Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots.
Track your progress under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.
Stunt jumps have extra challenges attached that do not need to be cleared for this trophy.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — no gold medals or wins needed, just one try of each. Fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: There are 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race (or race challenge, or Top Fun drone race) and performing a stunt.
Try each type once — no medal, win or score is needed, just one attempt.
PowerPyx lists the same nine: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Most of these happen naturally during the story and the 100% checklist, so this trophy usually pops on the way.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Guides disagree on whether there are 2 range locations or 12 — all agree on 42 golds. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some are locked until you meet their conditions.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: You need a gold medal in 42 Shooting Range challenges to unlock this trophy.
Two range locations are named: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero).
Other guides count 12 shooting range locations — the location count is disputed, the 42 gold medals are not.
Most challenges have three different difficulty tiers you need to complete and earn a gold medal in.
Some challenges are locked until you fulfil other conditions, which you can view on your map.
Find the locations on your map under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges, and track progress the same way.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. There are 42 races in total — one win per location earns the trophy, all 42 are needed for 100%. Some locations charge an entry fee.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: There are 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations in GTA 6.
Win one race at each location — 42 races exist in total, but one win per location is enough for the trophy.
All 42 races are needed for 100% completion, so keep racing after the trophy pops.
Some locations require entry fees. View the locations you have discovered under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations — winning the same race twice does not count. Most locations let you hire a car; check its Rating, and improve your own car with upgrades from Mod Shops.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: You need to win 20 different races; repeatedly winning the same one does not count.
There are 40 unique race locations across Leonida.
Most race locations let you hire cars — pay attention to the car's Rating if you plan to use your own.
Improve your own car's Rating with upgrades from Mod Shops, and track every race under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Racing.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. He texts you after Chapter 1's Feng Shui (Meet Cal) — follow the purple fishing icon, and catch the Parrotfish over 2kg he asks for. You need a boat with a fishing rod.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Cal texts you after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal) — follow his questline from the purple fishing icon.
Fairly early in the game you will receive a request from Cal to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg.
Fish in the area marked on your map until you catch a suitably sized fish.
You need a boat with a fishing rod to complete this — there are plenty in the area you can hijack if you do not have your own.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines. Finish all the levels once — challenges are not needed.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: There are 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the home TV, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines.
Complete any one of them — finish all its levels once.
The games' challenges are not needed for the trophy.
Three run on the TV at home and a fourth on arcade machines.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Lucia only, starting in Chapter 3 in Belville with a phone call. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain 1–3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Andy is Lucia only, starting in Chapter 3 in Belville.
The strand starts with a phone call in Chapter 3.
Work through the five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain 1–3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
Complete the final mission for Andy to earn the trophy.
Andy does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — only some stranger strands count there.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Treasure diving in Key Lento — 7 shipwrecks in total, with a metal detector. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so it is not missable; his final mission is Maritime Disputes.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Kenton is in Key Lento (green KR on the map) from Chapter 1 — treasure diving, with a metal detector.
There are 7 shipwrecks to dive in total.
He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later — temporarily unavailable, back in Chapters 2–3.
Call Brian as Jason to speed his return up.
His final mission is Maritime Disputes; track the sets under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. At the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, opening after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Five quests ending in Hometown Heroes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Billy is at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, opening after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Work through the five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
His final mission is Hometown Heroes.
Complete that final mission to earn the trophy.
Billy does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — only some stranger strands count there.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying mission strands for strangers. Only some strands count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Yago's race is time-sensitive — save first. Check the trophy's progress counter to confirm which strands count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Only some stranger strands count — Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not.
PowerPyx is still confirming which strands qualify — check the trophy's progress counter as you finish each strand.
Yago's Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) is time-sensitive — it carries an hourglass icon, so save first.
Strangers & Freaks is not part of the 100% checklist, so you may still need these 8 strands after the checklist is done.
One source says the chains behind the hidden trophies have story-linked windows — start each strand as soon as it unlocks to cover both versions.
You can do the strands after the story; the quest givers stay available in free roam.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. After Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — the Key Cloner and a 16-car sports car wishlist. Find the cars (green RK, west Vice City), scan them with WAiNK and deliver them in good condition for more pay.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Randy opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — the Key Cloner and a wishlist of 16 sports cars.
Find the cars around west Vice City (green RK on the map).
Scan each car with the WAiNK app, then deliver it.
Deliver in good condition for more pay.
Complete the final mission for Randy to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Jason only, from Chapter 3 after Here, Kitty Kitty — shut down the Synthetic Labs, then Spin On This. Tyrone does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Tyrone is Jason only, from Chapter 3 after Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs (Take Out Kitty Litter).
Then complete the final mission, Spin On This.
Tyrone does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — only some stranger strands count there.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. Meditate with both Jason and Lucia at a spot for +2. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation plays. The one possibly missable trophy: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations.
Meditate with both Jason and Lucia at a spot for +2 toward the count.
A meditation is not marked as complete until a final zen animation has played.
Track your progress under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
Meditations you have discovered also show on the map under Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Meditate Around Leonida.

Possibly missable: one morning in Chapter 1, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony at Jason's house (after Down to Earth). Follow her and accept the optional quest — that meditation is gone after Chapter 1.

PowerPyx reports the Chapter 1 balcony meditation raises the counter by one, but it is not marked as a meditation spot like the other 18 — whether the trophy needs it is unconfirmed. PowerPyx had done it when the trophy unlocked.

The last spot needs both leads playable — after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break per PowerPyx; OutputLag says switching opens right after Chapter 2's Breakfast Run. Either way, 100% needs only 15 of 18 meditations.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. Jason only, from Chapter 2 after Coffee Break — Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, with the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle. Which animal triggers it is unconfirmed; clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks (needed for 100%) should cover it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: Bret Vogel is Jason only, from Chapter 2 after Coffee Break.
His strand is Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, with the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle.
Which animal triggers the trophy is unconfirmed — PowerPyx has not confirmed it.
Clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which 100% needs, should cover it.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in total; 15 are needed for 100%, so this trophy comes on the way. Cards you sell at Pawn Shops still count toward your progress.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: There are 18 sets of collectible cards in the game.
You need to complete 3 sets for this trophy; 15 sets are required for 100% completion.
Track your progress under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards.
Any cards you have collected can be sold at Pawn Shops and will still contribute towards your progress.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher Tags with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1). There are 100+ scannable spots in total — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus the tags.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: WAiNK is an app on either Jason or Lucia's smartphone, opened by holding Up.
Scannable spots: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags.
Scan with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — 100+ spots exist in total, so you do not need every single one.
You need to have successfully scanned 100 of them for the trophy.
Check your progress at any time under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.
Scanning also counts toward Whip It Good — a scanned vehicle is a discovered vehicle.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in total, split into eight categories of 10, from Combat to Vehicle — all available from the start. 70 are needed for 100%, so this trophy comes on the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: There are 80 challenges in the game; you need 50 for this trophy and 70 for 100% completion.
Challenges are split into eight categories of 10, from Combat to Vehicle, and they are all available from the start.
View all the challenges and their requirements under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Challenges.
Challenges are in-game achievements that require skillful gameplay — they stack up passively across the story and the checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Earliest once both leads can roam together after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. The easy escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — or just do a bank vault job in Chapter 4, which gives 4 stars anyway.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: Get a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner along, then escape the red heat zone — not just the search area.
Earliest once both characters can roam together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner with hold Right plus Triangle.
The easy escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
Bank jobs give 4 stars anyway, so this also comes naturally during Chapter 4's vault jobs.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Keep the level flashing red and blue — if it goes to red heat, the chain breaks. Three jewelry stores north of Vice City work, after Chapter 3's Yasmani jewelry jobs; the trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
Keep the wanted level flashing red and blue — if it goes to red heat, the chain breaks.
Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline to survive three robberies in a row.
Three jewelry stores north of Vice City work, after Chapter 3's Yasmani jewelry jobs.
The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — if it does not pop, hit a fourth.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Getting inside one or scanning it with WAiNK is enough — you do not have to drive it. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: You discover a vehicle automatically when you get inside one or when you scan one.
You do not have to drive the vehicle — scanning it is enough.
PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models.
Scan every new vehicle as you go — the trophy should come naturally during the story.
Keep track of which vehicles you have discovered under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming). Fill Focus first — food and drinks, washing your face or a shower, and Adrenaline extends it. Gang enemies at illegal operations count; soldiers, police and civilians do not.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Use Combat Focus (L3 plus R3 while aiming) and take down 5 enemies in that one use.
Fill Focus first: eat and drink, wash your face or take a shower — Adrenaline extends it once it is going.
Use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556, on gang enemies at illegal operations.
It does not count on soldiers, police or civilians — gang members count. Focus has 4 levels, raised via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA — terminal E3 or E4; planes out on the airfield do not count. Drive it back to the airstrip, take off and fly about 1 km away. The pop is delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA (terminals E3 or E4) — planes out on the airfield do not count.
Enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport.
The trophy pop is delayed — keep flying until it appears.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, on the south-west island in Mariana County. The tanks sit south of the base — enter through the gate or by stunt jump at the south-east entrance. One guide notes a hidden combat requirement may apply; it is unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, on the south-west island in Mariana County.
The tanks sit south of the base — enter via the gate or by stunt jump at the south-east entrance.
U7BUY notes a hidden combat requirement may apply to this trophy; the exact condition is unconfirmed.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, from Chapter 3's Yasmani jewelry jobs. Use the back door — kicking it triggers the alarm. Inside: the backroom safe code note, destroy the security footage, disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you (Yasmani's jewelry jobs).
Use the back door — kicking it triggers the alarm.
Inside: find the backroom safe code note, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
Leave without being detected — the trophy is about stealth, not speed.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The vault jobs open through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail the security van to the bank, get the vault open and bring your partner to carry the bags. There are 8 large bank jobs in total — 5 for the trophy, 8 for 100%. Note: Push Square lists this trophy Bronze; the official list says Silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: The vault jobs open through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
Tail the security van to the bank, get the vault open and bring your partner to carry the bags.
Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000, after his Payday Loans quests.
There are 8 large bank jobs in total — 5 for this trophy, 8 for 100% — worth up to $205,000 per bank.
Expect a 4-star wanted level on the way out; escape by fast motorcycle.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank vault job counts as an armored truck robbery — or block a truck on the road, blow its back door with a sticky bomb and escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs come from Yasmani's shop.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: The first bank job counts as an armored truck robbery — do Maximum Withdrawal and this comes with it.
Or block an armored truck on the road and blow its back door open with a sticky bomb.
Then escape the heat radius.
Sticky bombs come from Yasmani's shop.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. 52 areas count toward it. A plane is the fastest way to unfog the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Clear the fog from the entire map.
52 areas count toward the trophy.
A plane is the fastest way to cover the map.
It stacks with the story and the 100% checklist — you will unfog most of Leonida just playing.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total — all 39 are needed for 100%. Track them under Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations in total.
Rob one illegal operation from each gang for this trophy.
All 39 operations are needed for 100% completion.
Track them under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The best-guess method — Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it beside the bar — is UNCONFIRMED: KeenGamer flags the trigger as not pinned down, though PowerPyx gives the bar and the drink as the method.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it beside the bar.
Method unconfirmed: KeenGamer flags the exact trigger as not pinned down, while PowerPyx gives the bar and the drink as the method — try it, but do not treat it as certain.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a GTA III easter egg. The best-guess method is a blue Banshee from a showroom in south Vice City, after the Chapter 3 Key Cloner mission, driven straight through the window. UNCONFIRMED: KeenGamer flags it, though PowerPyx gives the Banshee and the window as the method.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: Take a blue Banshee from a vehicle showroom in south Vice City, after the Chapter 3 Key Cloner mission.
Drive it straight through the showroom window — a GTA III easter egg.
Method unconfirmed: KeenGamer flags the exact trigger as not pinned down, while PowerPyx gives the Banshee and the window as the method.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kingpin Bowling alley in Port Gellhorn (Kolt & Associates). Take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the office safe — blown with sticky bombs — then escape the police. The operation respawns, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

steps.t: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (Kolt & Associates) and take all 3 key valuables.
The valuables: a luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the office safe — blow it with sticky bombs.
Then escape the police.
It is tied to the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but the operation respawns, so it is not missable.

trophies.guide: Max out Strength on both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Buy a gym membership and work out together — your partner trains alongside you. Check it under Touch Pad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength (heart icon). Only possible once both leads are playable, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Note: Push Square does not mark this trophy hidden; most lists do.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: Max out Strength for BOTH Jason and Lucia at once.
Buy a gym membership and work out together — your partner trains alongside you and both make progress.
Check it under Touch Pad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength (the heart icon).
Only possible once both leads are playable together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your Criminal Profile. It comes naturally across a full playthrough — click the trophy to see your current count. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications) so you can see what counts. Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes police more aggressive.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — click the trophy to see your current count.
The profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications) so you can see what counts.
The Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes police more aggressive — you can still earn everything, but cleanup gets harder.
It happens passively across a full playthrough; if you farm it, running over civilians and cops counts — cops shoot on sight at Psycho and Irredeemable.

trophies.guide: Method unknown. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue; U7BUY calls it a hidden second-chance event whose exact method remains unverified. This guide shows the best guess and labels it unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: Method unknown — PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
U7BUY calls it a hidden second-chance event; the exact method remains unverified.

trophies.guide: The UFO easter egg. On the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, alone: a blinking car, a path into the woods, a UFO dropping an abducted woman — help her and return to her car. PowerPyx gives this method; other guides list it as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, alone.
Look for a blinking car, then follow the path into the woods.
A UFO drops an abducted woman — help her, then return to her car.
Method unconfirmed: PowerPyx gives this method, but eGamers and KeenGamer list the trigger as unconfirmed.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. The best guess is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle; SixShore describes it as a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise conditions remain under investigation — unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: The best guess is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.
SixShore describes it as a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
U7BUY: the precise conditions remain under investigation — unconfirmed.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. The Dye Pack Jammer unlocks after Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew). Rob banks and payday loans, bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: The Dye Pack Jammer unlocks after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew).
Rob banks and payday loans to get marked bills.
Bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is cumulative across the whole game; it adds up across robberies.
Marked bills also count toward the 100% checklist's $250,000, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.
Launder the bills through your contacts — fences, not shops.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear, 18 hair and beauty, 11 tattoo and 15 electronics shops — the total is cumulative.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Spend $100,000 cumulative across all shops.
Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest.
The shops add up: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing, 17 footwear, 18 hair and beauty, 11 tattoo and 15 electronics.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count. The first is the Mitchel Auto Center at $4,000. Buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app, which arrives after Chapter 2's Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses). Each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — $160,000 in total.
The 4 story garages do not count toward this trophy.
First up: the Mitchel Auto Center at $4,000.
Buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app, after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses).
Each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles — pair this with On the Spot.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses): drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at Pay 'n' Spray. Register cheap cars to keep costs low.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register.
From Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at Pay 'n' Spray.
Register cheap cars to keep costs low — you need garage space first, so pair it with Little Boxes.
